run_trainer_finetune: run the Trainer to fine-tune a pretrained model on ImageNet and return final accuracy
create_trainer_state: create a TrainerState object to hold model, optimizer, and lr_scheduler state for checkpointing
save_trainer_state: save the TrainerState including model, optimizer, and lr_scheduler state dicts to a file
load_trainer_state: load a TrainerState from a checkpoint file using a default TrainerState to restore state dicts
checkpoint_trainer: checkpoint the current training state and optionally remove the initialization file
